title: Marguerite and the Kitchen
author: Petra Nakamura
blurb: Noor Dravenmoor, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
